overview: This one-page file consists of a cross-reference note directing researchers to despatch 894c.821/1, sent by Grummon from Dairen on April 23, 1935. The referenced despatch concerns the erection of a radio beacon near Choushuitzu, identified as the site of the Dairen airport, and was addressed to the U.S. Embassy.

people.name: Grummon
people.role: Sender of the referenced despatch from Dairen; official position not stated

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to despatch on radio beacon at Dairen airport
subfiles.about: The sheet refers researchers to despatch 894c.821/1 concerning construction of a radio beacon near Choushuitzu, the Dairen airport.
subfiles.summary: This filing note records that Grummon sent a despatch from Dairen to the Embassy on April 23, 1935. The despatch itself is filed elsewhere, under reference 894c.821/1. Its subject was the erection of a radio beacon near Choushuitzu, identified in the note as the Dairen airport.

interest: Although the substantive despatch is absent, this cross-reference preserves evidence of an aviation-navigation project at Dairen in 1935 and identifies where the fuller record was filed. It is useful for tracing the development of airport and radio-beacon infrastructure in Japanese-controlled Manchuria and for reconstructing links between related sections of the State Department decimal file.
